classification.difficultyReason: Construct and label an oblique configuration with A and C on the same side, locate the named angles, and recognise their measured sum as the co-interior supplementary relationship.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw two oblique parallel lines, $AB$ and $CD$, using opposite edges of your ruler.

answer.short: Two oblique parallel lines labelled $AB$ and $CD$.
answer.worked: Draw along one edge of the ruler and then its opposite edge without moving the ruler. Label the two parallel lines $AB$ and $CD$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Draw a transversal crossing these two parallel lines at an angle.

answer.short: A straight line crossing both parallel lines.
answer.worked: Add one straight line that intersects both $AB$ and $CD$, continuing the drawing in part a.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Let the transversal meet $AB$ at $X$ and $CD$ at $Y$. Label the endpoints so that $A$ and $C$ lie on the same side of the transversal.

answer.short: $X$ labels the intersection with $AB$; $Y$ labels the intersection with $CD$.
answer.worked: On the same drawing, label the intersection of the transversal and $AB$ as $X$, and its intersection with $CD$ as $Y$.

answer.short: Measurements depend on the drawing; the two measurements add to $180^\circ$.
answer.worked: Measure each angle with a protractor centred at its vertex and its baseline aligned with one arm, reading the scale that starts at $0^\circ$ on that arm. Since $A$ and $C$ lie on the same side of the transversal, $\angle AXY$ and $\angle CYX$ are co-interior angles. Their measurements add to $180^\circ$.

children.label: e
children.prompt: Write down the result that these measurements confirm.

answer.short: If a transversal crosses two parallel lines, the co-interior angles are supplementary.
answer.worked: $\angle AXY+\angle CYX=180^\circ$ (co-interior angles, $AB\parallel CD$). Thus co-interior angles formed by a transversal crossing parallel lines are supplementary.
